chunks: It is narrated from Ibn Faḍḍāl, from Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb, from someone who heard Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام say:
Most of the good is in women.

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah, Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام say about goodness in women?
ai.summary: This hadith attributes abundant goodness to women in a concise ethical statement. It highlights their positive worth and significance within human and social life.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4352 - It is narrated from Ibn Faddal, from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, from someone who heard Abu Abdillah (as) say: "
Most of the good is found in women."
